dependencies.runs: Original request/response and checker traces, model revisions and original hosted-model outcomes. Offline/free inference does not recover historical paid or closed-model runs.
dependencies.mutants: All 42 original mutant source files, baseline bindings, rule assignments, final-run traces and rejection-channel decisions, including independent second opinions.
dependencies.production: The ten exact adapted production sources, upstream commits, ordered rewrites/departures, argument signatures and launch metadata; nine accepted full-kernel proof projects and the rejected kernel trace.
dependencies.hardware: Original optimized kernels and numerical contracts, complete fastest-vendor baselines, H100 execution for PTX/CUDA and same-device MI300X HIP measurements. MI350X measurements cannot fill H100 cells.
dependencies.semantics: General packed/vector readers beyond the fixed profiles, arbitrary sparse subgroups and the authors' full optimized instruction registry remain unsupported software generality. The independent SiLU, weighted RMSNorm, seeded in-place fused add RMSNorm, native online attention, both native RoPE layouts, both fused QK/RoPE layouts, distinct FlashInfer RMSNorm, guarded packed SGLang RMSNorm and native FP16 single-split-K AWQ GEMM have complete source-bound actual-launch and actual-trace race-freedom proofs in their stated profiles. Their registered profiles publish 48 independent exports across nine accepted families; the real profiles also prove independent dense-reference equality. The original llm.c adaptation has an initialized race and complete one-row counterexample; its repair has whole-grid canonical-real correctness through a development checker and issues zero registered softmax certificates. SGLang's lane-zero repair is explicit. AWQ retains the paper's FP16-weight/single-split-K departures, with an independent AMD wave64 MFMA fragment mapping. These results do not reproduce the authors' original source registry, original model outcomes or NVIDIA measurements. IEEE/rounding error theorems remain outside the paper's formal claims.
dependencies.history: Authors' source tree and development records. An independent implementation cannot recreate historical person-days, original source-line totals or original code-sharing percentages.
dependencies.gqa_export: Authors' supplementary standalone GQA proof project and its pinned toolchain/dependencies; it was not present in the inspected manuscript archive or bounded release endpoints.
dependencies.specification: Authors' elaborated Lean module formalizations, metaprogram/reference tests, accepted shape/precision contracts and associated trusted-assumption reports. Independent reference validation now includes the two CPU numerical studies described in this ledger; they do not supply the original authors' modules or validation corpus.
